caseno: Appeal from Original Order No. 98 of 1996.
lawyer:
Mahmudul Islam, Advocate -----For the Appellant. 
Kh Mahbubuddin Ahmed with S M Munir, Advocates -----For the Respondents.
parties:
Fatema Khatun ------Appellant
Vs.
Wach Khatun and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 10. The learned Advocate further submits that on the basis of the documents both the courts below by the concurrent finding came to the opinion that the suit land appertains to khatian No.123 and there was no scope for any doubt as to identity as to the land in question and in such view of the matter the lower appellate Court while deciding the review application found fault with the judgment of both the courts below for not framing an issue on the point and for not deciding the identity of the suit property through an Advocate Commissioner. He further submits that the courts below considered the point of hotchpotch but the lower appellate Court held that the said point was not considered, the said learned Advocate finally submits that the grounds advocated in the review application are not grounds coming within the purview of Order 47 rule 1 of the Code and, as such, the impugned judgment suffers from the illegality and so is liable to be set aside.
